bullets.text: Residents of Gummidipoondi staged a road blockade protesting continuous power cuts and complained against electricity board officials, so the office should monitor power restoration in the area.
A car caught fire suddenly on the road near Velachery causing traffic disruption, so police are investigating the accident and the office should track safety updates.
Two people died in an accident on the Maduravoyal bypass road near Vanagaram after a motorist hit a truck, so the office should watch traffic safety measures.
The state highways department desilted three culverts along Jawaharlal Nehru Salai near Velachery MRTS station to prevent floods, so the office should track monsoon preparedness.
Anbumani Ramadoss inspected the three-kilometer compound wall and walkway construction in the Pallikaranai marshland, so the office should monitor environmental protection works there.
Water is being released from the Poondi reservoir through a link canal to Puzhal and Chembarambakkam reservoirs to meet drinking water needs, so the office should monitor water levels.
In Ponneri, infrastructure works face delays in issuing work orders leaving people struggling, so the office should expedite administrative approvals.
The eastern tower of the Tiruttani Murugan temple was closed for chariot street expansion and Rajagopuram connection works, so the office should oversee project progress.
Tamil Nadu is witnessing continuous expansion of global capability centres and attracting new setups, so the office should support further IT sector investments.
Housing and Urban Development principal secretary announced that the AI-based planning approval software SPEED will be introduced, so the office should track its rollout.
Edappadi K. Palaniswami criticized the government on social media regarding the inauguration of the Porur-Poonamallee metro rail, so the office should monitor political reactions.
TVK IT wing warned AIADMK that criticizing Vijay will further harm their party following by-poll defeats, so the office should watch inter-party tensions.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister Vijay inaugurated the Poonamallee-Vadapalani metro stretch and announced development projects worth Rs 13,000 crore, so the office should track project execution.
Chief Minister Vijay presented 12 key demands to Prime Minister Modi during the event at IIT Madras, so the office should follow up on central cooperation.
